notes.title: Tuesday's AMA is in class
notes.body: The student-platforms AMA on your calendar for Tuesday starts at 12:00 Paris time, which is inside the Business Foundations class block of 08:00 to 14:30. You added it on the 8th, a day before the module hours were sent. - Worth asking the Learning Experience team whether it will be recorded.

notes.title: Two internship sessions
notes.body: Newsletter #11 this morning lists a British International Investment presentation on Wednesday, applications open tomorrow and closing 6 December, and a Tata Group session on the 24th. Tata needs you registered by Thursday 16:00 to be sent the link. - Both land inside your class week, so register now if either interests you.
